long_form.title: Building Voice Agents with Gemini 3
long_form.description:
*Build real-time conversational agents with Gemini 3*
Thor from Google DeepMind walks through the Gemini Live API, showing how to build natural, human-like voice interactions powered by Gemini’s native audio model: speech-to-speech, no text in the middle, with emotional nuance, multilingual support,
